title: Common
description: Shared basic types of the contract.

utcInstant.description: Absolute point in time in UTC, ISO 8601 with seconds and Z (D-12).

scope.description: a country, country-independent (global) or the border zone beyond DACH (border)

isoCountry.description: any country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. FR

layerId.description: id of a layer of the layer registry (contract/catalog/layers.json, generated from the layer plugins); open, because layers can come as plugins
